summary: Nuclei là scanner lỗ hổng nhanh và tùy biến, dùng YAML DSL để phát hiện lỗ hổng trong ứng dụng, API, mạng, DNS và cấu hình đám mây.
usecases: Automated security testing in CI/CD pipelines to detect CVEs and vulnerabilities.
Subdomain takeover detection and attack surface mapping for bug bounty programs.
Custom security scanning for cloud infrastructure and API endpoints.
ideas: Integrate with IaC tools to scan infrastructure configs for security misconfigurations before deployment.
Combine with subdomain enumeration tools for comprehensive subdomain vulnerability assessment.
Develop a web UI dashboard for visualizing Nuclei scan results across multiple targets.
